reason: Paper 2 builds a working pipeline (cursor filter, learned inverse-dynamics action detection and parameterization) that mines 1.52M steps from unlabeled videos, and it shows clear downstream gains: OSWorld-Verified 9.3% to 14-15.8% and AgentNetBench 64.1% to 69.3%, with a data-scaling ablation. It has gaps, such as no token-matched control and a single 50-step run. Paper 1 only benchmarks three existing distillers on noisy CIFAR/Tiny-ImageNet. It compares against full-noisy-data CE training rather than any noisy-label method, and its 'corollaries' are unproven, near-trivial bounds, so its main claims of a new denoising approach with privacy benefits are not substantiated.
